programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Jamesy Boy
programme.desc: Un jeune délinquant en prison se lie d'amitié avec un meurtrier qui deviendra son mentor.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Deux amis bientôt étudiants universitaires (Ansel Elgort et Chloë Grace Moretz) tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre. Mais après le meurtre mystérieux de leur camarade de classe, ils défient les autorités de découvrir la vérité.

programme.title: L'amour d'une mère
programme.desc: Mariée et mère de famille, Laney mène en apparence une vie paisible. Mais c'est sans compter sur la drogue, les rencontres avec d'autres hommes et son habitude de disparaitre sans prévenir.

programme.title: Comment séduire une amie
programme.desc: Un scénariste de film qui travaille sur le script d'une comédie romantique peine à y arriver alors qu'il ne peut lui-même entretenir une relation amoureuse. Il finit cependant par rencontrer la fille parfaite? jusqu'à ce qu'il réalise qu'elle est déjà fiancée.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: Dans les années 1980, Rory, un ancien courtier devenu un ambitieux entrepreneur, convainc Allison, son épouse américaine, et leurs deux enfants de quitter le confort d'une banlieue cossue des États-Unis pour s'installer en Angleterre, son pays de naissance.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Une femme belle, dérangée et dangereuse devient obsédée par un homme marié récemment installé dans le quartier et sème le chaos dans tous les aspects de la vie du couple.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: Diana la Photo Interdite
programme.desc: Documentaire sur la dernière photo de Diana prise dans la Mercedes accidentée sous le pont de l'Alma. Cette photo a circulé quelques heures dans la nuit de l'accident, fait la fortune du photographe et de son agence avant d'être retirée sous les menaces de Buckingham.

programme.title: Gladiator: Marvin Musquin 1/2
programme.desc: Marvin Musquin, double champion du monde de motocross, a décidé de passer dans la catégorie reine de sa discipline. Ce film suit sa préparation.

programme.title: Islam Contre Islam
programme.desc: Chiites contre Sunnites, l'affrontement des deux branches de l'Islam : une clé pour comprendre bon nombre des tensions qui secouent le Moyen-Orient.

programme.title: Berlusconi, Pouvoir et Décadence
programme.desc: Une vie de bling-bling et de bunga bunga : crooner, homme d'affaires et de télévision, Silvio Berlusconi, décédé à l'âge de 86 ans, a profondément marqué le paysage politique de son pays, une "success story" à l'italienne émaillée de nombreux scandales, entre grandeur et décadence.

programme.title: Diana la Photo Interdite
programme.desc: Documentaire sur la dernière photo de Diana prise dans la Mercedes accidentée sous le pont de l'Alma. Cette photo a circulé quelques heures dans la nuit de l'accident, fait la fortune du photographe et de son agence avant d'être retirée sous les menaces de Buckingham.

programme.title: Gladiator: Marvin Musquin 1/2
programme.desc: Marvin Musquin, double champion du monde de motocross, a décidé de passer dans la catégorie reine de sa discipline. Ce film suit sa préparation.

programme.title: Islam Contre Islam
programme.desc: Chiites contre Sunnites, l'affrontement des deux branches de l'Islam : une clé pour comprendre bon nombre des tensions qui secouent le Moyen-Orient.

programme.title: 30 Minutes Maximum
programme.desc: Livreur de pizzas, Nick est kidnappé par deux apprentis criminels. Ceux-ci fixent sur sa poitrine une bombe qu'ils menacent de faire exploser s'il refuse de cambrioler une banque. Nick n'a que quelques heures pour accomplir sa mission impossible. Affolé, il demande l'aide de son ex-meilleur ami, Chet. L'heure tourne, et voilà les deux complices obligés d'échapper à la police, à un tueur à gages, à un lance-flammes… Mais le plus difficile pour eux dans tout ça, c'est encore d'arriver à s'entendre !

programme.title: Amours Troubles
programme.desc: Gigli (Ben Affleck), un petit voyou de quartier, a la réputation de s'attirer de gros problèmes. Ricki (Jennifer Lopez), quant à elle, est une gangster endurcie. Lorsqu'ils se retrouvent ensemble sur une mission qui tourne mal, vont-ils trouver un moyen de dépasser leurs différences personnelles et leur attirance mutuelle ? Réalisé par Martin Brest (Scent of a Woman), GIGLI est une comédie romantique rythmée assez chaude !

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Doug Kinney, contremaitre dans une entreprise de construction, est gagne par le stress. Son travail ne lui laisse aucun repit et il a a peine le temps de voir sa femme et ses deux enfants, qu'il adore. Il trouve une solution a tous ces problemes quand il fait la connaissance d'un chercheur en genetique qui lui propose de creer un clone, un autre lui-meme.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Un jeune homme pressé d'être père confond un jeune garçon qu'il doit adopter avec un criminel en fuite qui a la particularité d'avoir un visage poupin et d'être de petite taille. Mais ce dernier se rend vite compte qu'il vaut mieux avoir les flics aux fesses plutôt que des couches !

programme.title: Où sont passés les Morgan?
programme.desc: Un couple séparé de New York est le témoin d'un meurtre et est placé sous protection des témoins dans un village du Wyoming.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: Deux gérants adjoints d'un supermarché s'affrontent pour décrocher un poste convoité.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Braquage à l'allemande
programme.desc: Quatre hommes, trahis par la banque, s'unissent pour se venger.

programme.title: Mauvaise connexion!
programme.desc: Un couple usé par le temps, Dan et Janice Dewerson, décide de s'organiser un week-end en amoureux en même temps qu'une " détox numérique ". Mais ce qui commence comme un séjour romantique et parfait va vite tourner à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Permis de tromper
programme.desc: Camila et Mateo forment un couple très heureux depuis 8 ans. A l'occasion d'un diner entre amis, ils se prêtent au jeu du « permis de tromper » : chacun choisit la célébrité avec laquelle une aventure « serait » autorisée.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Big Foot
programme.desc: En 1970, deux hommes aux destins opposés : Harley Anderson et Simon Quint doivent s'unir pour chasser une créature légendaire vivant dans les montagnes : le `Big foot'.

programme.title: Disappearance
programme.desc: Une famille en vacances se retrouve dans une ville-fantôme où sévit une force mystérieuse.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: Ultimate Chabite
programme.desc: Kevin, Antho, Erwan et Rodrigo lancent un chabite, qui ne va jamais s'arrêter. Au départ c'est un simple jeu viral et absurde, mais très vite les complications arrivent. Les accidents se multiplient et les autorités commencent à s'y intéresser, tandis qu'Antho, le plus radical des 4 amis...

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: Appelez-moi Dave
programme.desc: Des mini extra-terrestres débarquent sur Terre dans un vaisseau leur permettant de passer inaperçus : la réplique parfaite d'un homme. Mais se comporter en humain s'avère bien compliqué.

programme.title: L'arrivée
programme.desc: Le radio-astronome Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) croit avoir capté un bruit cosmique qui signale l'intelligence extraterrestre. Sa recherche désespérée de réponses l'amène au Mexique à une centrale nucléaire mystérieuse, où il est arrêté pour le meurtre d'un scientifique.

programme.title: Hector et la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Quand il réalise que ses patients sont heureux, Hector, un psychanalyste londonien entre en crise... Il se met alors à la recherche du bonheur en parcourant le globe.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Un soldat américain est confronté à un dilemme éthique lorsqu'il entame une relation avec la veuve d'un officier tombé au combat.

programme.title: Measure Of Revenge
programme.desc: Le fils de Lillian Cooper meurt mystérieusement. Lorsque le policier chargé de l'enquête conclut à une overdose accidentelle, Lillian mène sa propre enquête.

programme.title: My All American
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Freddie Steinmark, star du football dans son collège, qui se voit diagnostiquer un cancer après avoir remporté le titre national de 1969.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal. Un étudiant blessé par balle et une employée de supérette kidnappée se retrouvent au foyer de la fraternité. La panique persiste.

programme.title: La victoire dans le sang
programme.desc: Père et fils, Sam et Cam Munroe travaillent dans le même garage et partagent une passion identique pour le stock-car. Sam décide de reprendre la compétition et y retrouve son fils.

programme.title: Flashbacks of a Fool
programme.desc: Daniel Craig livre une performance étonnante dans le rôle de Joe Scot, une star hollywoodienne has-been à la dérive plongé dans un brouillard de sexe, de drogues et de gloire dilapidée.

programme.title: Macabro
programme.desc: Basé sur l'histoire vraie d'Ibraim et Henrique de Oliveira, les "Frères Nécrophiles", deux jeunes frères sont accusés de meurtres brutaux dans les années 90, au Brésil.

programme.title: Scanners
programme.desc: Une société cherche à regrouper les Scanners, des médiums aux pouvoirs surnaturels. Elle recrute un jeune médium pour détecter tous les Scanners qui lui sont opposés. Il va découvrir les aspects cachés de cette périlleuse mission.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Night Shot
programme.desc: Une jeune blogueuse spécialisée dans l'exploration urbaine (urbex) décide d'aller visiter un gigantesque hôpital abandonné. Comme toujours elle part seule et de nuit avec son cameraman, afin de faire vivre en direct ses aventures à ses followers, avec une particularité : ne jamais couper la caméra ! Mais ce soir le lieu qu'elle a choisi va lui faire vivre un véritable cauchemar, les drames du passé y ont laissé leurs traces…

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Les Révoltés
programme.desc: Dans une Amérique tyrannisée par des miliciens, des amis cherchent à fuir au Canada.

programme.title: Collection
programme.desc: Brandon, collecteur de dettes brisé par la perte de son fils, hésite à ruiner Christina, une mère seule piégée par les crimes de son mari. Contre ses principes et son partenaire, il choisit de l'aider.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: Un immense vaisseau accueille une compétition de sport spatial appelé Cosmoball.

programme.title: Creuser pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un père et sa fille sourde sont forcés par des criminels de creuser sous une maison abandonnée.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Six inconnus piégés dans un champ de maïs doivent s'unir pour échapper à une mystérieuse menace.

programme.title: The Resistance Fighter
programme.desc: À la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, un courageux héros de guerre devient un agent du gouvernement polonais chargé d'obtenir l'aide de l'Angleterre contre l'Allemagne.

programme.title: The Party Crasher
programme.desc: Sigma Tau, une fraternité étudiante, organise une fête hawaïenne. Rapidement, les jeunes gens réalisent qu'une entité surnaturelle et malveillante a pris possession des lieux.

programme.title: Asher
programme.desc: Ancien agent du Mossad, Asher est désormais mercenaire professionnel. Proche de prendre sa retraite, il rencontre Sophie et va tenter avec elle de mener une vie normale avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Lady Gun Fighter
programme.desc: 1882, dans une île au sud de la Nouvelle-Zélande, une mère se lance sur les traces du meurtrier de son mari, responsable de l'enlèvement de son fils.

programme.title: La Résurrection du Christ
programme.desc: Un agent de la CIA corrompu, Sands, l'engage pour déjouer un complot visant à assassiner le président du Mexique. Ce que Sands ignore, c'est que le Desperado revient uniquement pour se venger. Avec ses 2 comparses, Lorenzo et Fideo, il va raviver sa légende...

programme.title: Plus Jamais

Celle-ci vit dorénavant un conte de fée avec sa fille et son mari. Mais, la vraie nature de Mitch se révèle. Slim va tout faire alors pour ne plus subir en tant que victime mais va agir pour être à présent l'adversaire.

programme.title: Memoire Effacee

Et elle ne retrouve effectivement aucune trace du disparu... En compagne d'Ash, qui a aussi perdu son enfant dans le même crash aérien, Telly va tenter de faire éclater la vérité

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Hanna (SAOIARSE RONAN) a 16 ans. Elle est intelligente, curieuse, jolie - et se révèle être un assassin professionnel. Ayant passé presque toute sa vie dans la toundra à apprendre des techniques de combat enseignées par son père (ERIC BANA), elle revient à la civilisation où un agent sans scrupules de la CIA (CATE BLANCHETT) tente de la faire disparaître. Tout en apprenant comment elle est devenue une machine à tuer, Hanna doit se battre pour survivre et finalement, éliminer la personne qui est responsable de ce qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Chile: Episode 2
programme.desc: Chile is at the mercy of weather systems that have shaped the nation. In the South, strong westerlies bring rains that create rich green Valdivian forests, carpeting the neotropic ecozone. The Valdivian forests of Chile are a unique ecosystem harbouring species of a ‘land before time' – The forests of Valdivia represent the unique assemblage of ancient species, both floral and faunal, which today persist as relicts of Gondwanaland.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Peru, a silky anteater is fighting to stay awake and a mother humming bird is struggling to raise her chick. The seasonal downpours are about to begin and the rainforest's animals must strive to cope with the changing conditions. Through millions of years of evolution they have developed bizarre relationships and unexpected strategies to overcome them, but for all their ingenuity, they were never prepared for the arrival of a new species on the scene.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Chile: Episode 2
programme.desc: Chile is at the mercy of weather systems that have shaped the nation. In the South, strong westerlies bring rains that create rich green Valdivian forests, carpeting the neotropic ecozone. The Valdivian forests of Chile are a unique ecosystem harbouring species of a ‘land before time' – The forests of Valdivia represent the unique assemblage of ancient species, both floral and faunal, which today persist as relicts of Gondwanaland.

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila
programme.desc: In South East Asia the Greater Adjutant Stork, known locally as the Hargila, is a sight to behold. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Dangerous Trails: Elephants in the Minefield
programme.desc: This film tells the story of peace and resettlement in Angola. After decades of civil War, the Elephants are returning via routes riddled with landmines. We show the challenge of both elephants and people reclaiming their land and living together.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Chased Dreamers

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch. Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere...

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - April Smurf's Day: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Never Smurf Off Till Tomorrow: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess

She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Fury Spinner

Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: The Legend Of Bhopal

programme.title: Kissa Currency Ka
programme.desc: The introduction of currency was a key step in the evolution of civilization. As the kingdoms and dynasties across the country rose and fell, they left their mark on the currency they produced. This series explores the coins minted by each kingdom in Indian history, and uses stories about the coins to tell the history of the kingdom itself.

programme.title: The new Porsche 911 GT3 R
programme.sub-title: Design - The new Porsche 911 GT3 R - Design_en
programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. A seven-speed manual transmission with a particularly short throw is available for all 911 GTS models as an alternative to the PDK.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created - From concept vehicle to full-production ID
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.sub-title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Product Highlights_en
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.sub-title: Digital Future Lighting - TechDay Digital Light - Digital Future Lighting
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: 2022 Peugeot 308
programme.sub-title: Crash & Safety Tests - 2022 Peugeot 308 - Crash & Safety Tests
programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Volvo Cars and Epic Games bring real-time photorealistic visualisation
programme.desc: To offer its customers the best possible user experience, Volvo Cars is bringing photorealistic visualisation technology into its next generation of electric cars through a new collaboration with Epic Games. The companies are teaming up to bring Epic's Unreal Engine game engine into upcoming Volvo cars, providing unparalleled high-quality graphics inside the cabin. Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment and software company probably best known for Fortnite, one of the world's largest games. Epic Games also develops Unreal Engine, widely considered to be the most advanced real-time 3D creation tool used in various industries beyond games, and which will now be used by Volvo Cars for developing digital interfaces inside its cars and rendering real-time graphics in the car.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.
